Effectivity
-This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen (15) days
after its publication in at least one (1) national paper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of May, in the year of Our Lord Two
Thousand and Six.
"7
By the President:
Eduardo R. Ermita
